student_qa_data.question: Look at the picture on the right. Label the poles on each magnet. (The bottom 2 magnets are stuck together, the others are not.) What is the rule that explains why you labeled the poles the way you did?
student_qa_data.question_answer: Like poles repel and opposite poles attract.
student_qa_data.student_answer: The rings do not touch because the top is south pole is the one below it is the south pole. When the poles are north and south they attract.

student_qa_data.question: What is the main job of muscles in the body?
student_qa_data.question_answer: The main job of muscles is to move bones.

student_qa_data.question: Pete put a marble in a cup of water as shown in the picture. What evidence indicates whether the marble is more or less dense than the water?
student_qa_data.question_answer: The marble is on the bottom of the cup (under the water).
student_qa_data.student_answer: The marble is at the bottom.

student_qa_data.question: Look at the picture of a block of wood in a cup of water. What evidence indicates that the block of wood is less dense than the water?
student_qa_data.question_answer: The block of wood floats because the wood is less dense than water.

student_qa_data.question: Pam and her family were planning a hike. Pam found 2 maps of the same area. Her friend recommended she use the topographic map when they went to the lake. Which letter (Q, R, or S) on the map is on the steepest part of the trail? (Q) How do you know it is the steepest part of the trail?
student_qa_data.question_answer: The contour lines are closest together at Q.
